outcome.answer: A graph structure can help by expanding the decoding space so the reranker explores multiple paths instead of committing to one high-likelihood sequence, which reduces repetition and increases diversity [2]. In that paper, the graph-structured model explicitly models item dependencies from graph transitions and is designed to generate more diverse sequences [2]. The closest other graph-based reranking papers use graphs for retrieval completeness or refinement, not specifically for fixing repetitive generative item lists [1, 5, 8].
